We show you the problem before we fix it

Most calls start with someone wrenching. Ours start with a flashlight: we find your shut-off, point at what failed, and write the price down before a part comes off the van.

  • You see itCamera footage, a gauge reading or a finger on the pipe.

Three checks you can do tonight

Check it yourself before you call

Where is my main shut-off?

In most Indianapolis basements it sits on the front wall, right after the meter. Tick each step as you do it.

My valve won't turn

01 · MAIN SHUT-OFF

Location: ______________________________

Valve: lever / round wheel    Turns: clockwise to close

Tested on: ____________ by ____________

Wrench & Wren Plumbing · (317) 555-0107

How much life is left in my water heater?

Tank heaters in hard Indianapolis water usually give 8 to 12 years. Tick what you notice; the gauge moves with you.

Price a heater visit

Is my water pressure in the safe range?

Screw a gauge onto an outside spigot, open it all the way, and read the needle. Normal is 40 to 80 psi.

60 psi: inside the normal 40 to 80 range. Nothing to do.

  • Under 40 Weak showers; often a failing regulator or old galvanized pipe.
  • 40 to 80 Normal. Leave it alone.
  • Over 80 Banging pipes, running toilets. A regulator fixes it.
